js: (async()=>{const raw=await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8931/api/interactive/boards/board_default/state')).json();const j=raw.state||raw;const s=document.querySelector('.board-surface').getBoundingClientRect();const surf={l:Math.round(s.left),t:Math.round(s.top),w:Math.round(s.width),h:Math.round(s.height)};const tf=getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.board-surface')).transform;const vp=document.querySelector('.board-viewport');const cards=(j.cards||[]).filter(c=>!c.deleted).map(c=>({id:c.id,x:c.x,y:c.y,w:c.w,h:c.h}));const last=(window.__pm||[]).slice(-3);const lastPt=last.length?last[last.length-1]:null;const board=lastPt?{x:lastPt.x-surf.l,y:lastPt.y-surf.t}:null;const hit=board?cards.filter(c=>board.x>=c.x&&board.x<=c.x+c.w&&board.y>=c.y&&board.y<=c.y+c.h).map(c=>c.id):[];return JSON.stringify({mark:"probe", surf, transform:tf, scroll:[vp.scrollLeft,vp.scrollTop], lastMoves:last, boardPoint:board, cards, hit});})()
